la:noun:pratum.html:
prātum, i, n. (collat. form prātus, m., Gromat. Vet. p. 322, 5) [root prat-; Sanscr. prath, to spread out; cf. Gr. πλατύς, πλάτανος],
a meadow (class.).
Lit.: pratum irriguum, aut siccum,: stercorare,: irrigua facere,; prooem.: pratorum viriditas,: irrigare,: cratire, secare, caedere, sicilire,; : cultus prati,: siccaneum, aut riguum,; .—
Transf.
Meadow-grass (poet.): condita prata in patinis proferre,; .—
A broad field, plain;poet., of the sea: rostro Neptunia prata secare,.
